sents.en: Mercury is a planet.
Planets orbit stars.
Planets in our solar system orbit the sun.
sents.ko: 우리 태양계의 행성들은 태양 주위를 돌아요.

sents.en: Mercury is the closest planet to the sun.
It is about 36 million miles (58 million km) from the sun.
sents.ko: 태양에서 약 3,600만 마일(5,800만 km) 떨어져 있어요.

sents.en: Mercury orbits the sun every 88 days.
One year on Mercury is 88 days on Earth.
Mercury spins while it orbits the sun.
sents.ko: 수성은 태양을 도는 동안 스스로 회전해요.

sents.en: It spins very slowly.
The spin makes day and night.
One day on Mercury is 59 days on Earth.
Mercury has three layers.
sents.ko: 수성은 세 개의 층으로 되어 있어요.

sents.en: It has a core, mantle, and crust.
Its core is made of iron.
Mercury's terrain is rough.
It is covered in large craters.
Mercury can be very hot or cold.
sents.ko: 수성은 아주 뜨겁거나 아주 추울 수 있어요.

sents.en: Humans and animals cannot live there.
sents.ko: 사람과 동물은 거기서 살 수 없어요.

sents.en: Plants cannot live there either.
You can see Mercury from Earth.
You can see it without a telescope.
Oh, Mercury is very different from Earth.
It's kind of gloomy.
There is no grass, there are no flowers, no animals.
sents.ko: 풀도 없고, 꽃도 없고, 동물도 없어요.

sents.en: But, Mercury is still such a cool planet.
I'll see you next time.
And I hope you come here again. Bye!
